notes.title: The Ways of Uron v0.1.11
notes.content:
[b]Additions:[/b]

-Fixed an issue that caused incorrect aspect ratios on linux devices
-Added Set Resolution function to the Options Menu

Note: For players using the Steamdeck to output to an external display device: Set your resolution option for the game in the Steamdeck menu first, then set the resolution in game and it should work.

Warning: Using the "default" or "native" resolution options in the steamdeck menu seems to lock you to steamdeck's native resolution (1280x800)  Press "p" on the keyboard when in the Ungaloo Zone to toggle resolution information.

[b]Thank you for your interest in The Ways of Uron[/b]

notes.title: The Ways of Uron v0.1.10
notes.content:
[b]Additions:[/b]

-Added a small dialogue scene when the dragon boss is defeated
-Added more smoke to the Pixie Dust animation to better indicate damage
-Enraged water dragons will now have a bit more health
-Fixed pixel artifacts on the tree canopy
-Improvements to bounder animation and bounder hovel sprite
-Layos now assists you in combat (he can't take damage yet, making him a bit overpowered)

This update will reset all playtesters' save files. To reset this yourself, press 'Y' on the keyboard, then Alt+F4 to quit the game.

[b]Thank you for your interest in The Ways of Uron[/b]

notes.title: The Ways of Uron v0.1.09
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
-Improved animation for base Garen sprite
-added a broader sweep for the second attack in the weapon combo chain (both Sword & Staff).  Hopefully, this will make the weapon combo feel better.

[b]Information:[/b]
The bosses associated with the Quake and Fireball will continue to spawn even after obtaining the spells, this will continue for the time-being for testing purposes.
Layos, your canine companion, will lead you to your next quest target. (however, some items you must find on your own)  Eventually, Layos will be able to attack and take damage, and be controlled by a second player.

[b]Thank you for your interest in The Ways of Uron[/b]

notes.title: The Ways of Uron is now available for playtesting
notes.content:
The Ways of Uron is now available for playtesting.

The player starts with the Otukai Staff and can collect up to 7 more items to use in 'The Ways of Uron's top-down 2D action combat.

This is a tech demo.  So, only very minimalistic story elements are included.  The playtester can wander in any direction and Ungaloo (the first zone of 5 planned) will be procedurally generated before you. 

Feedback is very important for us at this stage - Issues can be discussed on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1382080/discussions/]forums[/url] and we will maintain a list of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1382080/discussions/0/3836550120028050579/]known bugs[/url].

Signups are now available on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1382080/The_Ways_of_Uron/]store page[/url] by clicking 'Request Access'.

Thank you for your interest in The Ways of Uron!
